cases.query: what can replace buttermilk and give the same tanginess in pancakes?
cases.top_hit: 1 cup whole milk + 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice (rest 10 min)

cases.query: vegan substitute for buttermilk in cornbread
cases.top_hit: 1 cup unsweetened soy milk + 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar

cases.query: replace egg as a binder in meatballs
cases.top_hit: 1 tbsp ground flaxseed + 3 tbsp warm water (rest 10 min until gelled)

cases.query: replace egg for airy lift and leavening in sponge cake
cases.top_hit: 1 tsp baking soda + 1 tbsp white or apple cider vinegar

cases.query: vegan substitute for whipped egg whites in meringue
cases.top_hit: 3 tbsp aquafaba (chickpea cooking liquid) whipped with pinch cream of tartar

cases.query: what can I use instead of sugar in a banana shake?
cases.top_hit: 3/4 cup pure maple syrup per 1 cup sugar (reduce liquid by 3 tbsp)

cases.query: unrefined Indian sweetener replacement for brown sugar in kheer
cases.top_hit: 1 cup grated jaggery (gur) or palm/coconut sugar per 1 cup sugar

cases.query: substitute for tamarind paste in sambar
cases.top_hit: 1 tsp amchur (dried mango powder) + 1 tsp lime juice + 1/2 tsp jaggery

cases.query: what replaces kokum in coastal fish curry?
cases.top_hit: 1 tbsp tamarind pulp + splash of pomegranate juice or lime juice

cases.query: dry citrus spice alternative for ground sumac in fattoush
cases.top_hit: 1 tsp finely grated lemon zest + 1/2 tsp citric acid or splash of lemon juice

cases.query: vegan substitute for fish sauce umami in stir-fry
cases.top_hit: 1 tbsp soy sauce + 1/4 tsp rice vinegar + pinch of crushed nori or mushroom powder

cases.query: vegetarian replacement for oyster sauce in noodles
cases.top_hit: 1 tbsp vegetarian mushroom stir-fry sauce (or 2 tsp soy sauce + 1 tsp hoisin + pinch sugar)

cases.query: what can replace miso paste in ramen broth?
cases.top_hit: 2 tsp tahini + 1 tsp soy sauce + pinch of nutritional yeast

cases.query: dairy-free substitute for grated parmesan cheese on pasta
cases.top_hit: 3 tbsp nutritional yeast + 1 tbsp finely ground raw cashews + 1/4 tsp salt

cases.query: vegan replacement for anchovy fillets in puttanesca sauce
cases.top_hit: 1 tbsp chopped capers + 1/2 tsp miso paste + pinch of kelp/nori

cases.query: substitute for asafoetida hing in dal tadka
cases.top_hit: 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp onion powder bloomed in hot oil/ghee

cases.query: what can replace gochujang chili paste in bibimbap?
cases.top_hit: 1 tbsp red miso + 1 tsp gochugaru or cayenne + 1 tsp honey/maple + 1/2 tsp rice vinegar

cases.query: substitute for chipotle in adobo in tacos
cases.top_hit: 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1/4 tsp cayenne + 1 tsp tomato paste + 1/2 tsp cider vinegar

cases.query: what replaces kasuri methi dried fenugreek leaves in butter masala?
cases.top_hit: 1 tbsp dried celery leaves + 1/4 tsp crushed fennel seeds

cases.query: substitute for fresh curry leaves in South Indian tadka
cases.top_hit: 1 bay leaf + 1/2 tsp finely grated lime zest bloomed in hot oil

cases.query: what can I use instead of coconut chutney with masala dosa?
cases.top_hit: Roasted Peanut (Groundnut) Chutney blended with roasted chana dal, green chili, ginger, tamarind & curry leaf tadka

cases.query: vegan substitute for paneer in palak paneer
cases.top_hit: 200g pressed extra-firm tofu (tossed with 1/2 tsp lemon juice & pinch salt) or halloumi

cases.query: dairy-free heavy cream substitute for tomato gravy
cases.top_hit: 1/2 cup soaked raw cashews blended silky-smooth with 3/4 cup water

cases.query: glossy sauce thickener replacement for cornstarch
cases.top_hit: 1 tbsp arrowroot powder or potato starch (mixed in cold water slurry)

cases.query: vegan meaty substitute for boneless chicken in biryani
cases.top_hit: Hydrated soya chunks (meal maker), king oyster mushrooms, or young green jackfruit
